text: dsh-http-probe 是一个面向 DSH Web 客户端的插件，通过注册 http_probe 工具让 agent 检查 HTTP(S) 端点。工具默认发送 HEAD 请求，在状态码为 405 或 501 时回退一次 GET，并返回状态码、响应延迟以及 content-type、server、cache-control 和 location 等可用响应头；它不读取响应体。每次请求有 10 秒超时，也会响应工具调用取消。适合快速检查网站或 API 是否可访问，无需配置密钥；调用时会向所选 URL 发起 HTTP 请求。

dsh-http-probe adds an http_probe tool to DSH web for HTTP(S) checks. It uses HEAD by default, retries with GET on 405 or 501, and reports status, latency, and selected headers without reading the body. Requests time out after 10 seconds. Each call contacts the supplied URL; no API key is needed.
想让 DSH 帮我快速确认一个网站或 API 是否在线。
检查某个 HTTP 地址的状态码和响应延迟。
Check an HTTP endpoint and report its status, response time, and key headers.
dsh-http-probe 的功能「HTTP 探测」：调用 http_probe 提供 HTTP(S) 地址和可选方法，即可查看状态码、延迟与部分响应头。
dsh-http-probe 的功能「HEAD 失败时回退」：未指定方法时若 HEAD 返回 405 或 501，工具再尝试一次 GET；显式选择 GET 时则直接报告响应，不执行该回退。
dsh-http-probe 使用前须知：调用工具会向调用者提供的 HTTP(S) URL 发出请求，并返回该端点响应的状态和部分响应头；每个请求最多等待 10 秒。

dsh-http-probe README · dsh-http-probe：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that adds an `http_probe` tool: the agent can check the status code, latency and key response headers of any HTTP(S) endpoint without reading response bodies. Useful for API health checks and quick "is this site up?" questions.

一个 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 插件，提供 `http_probe` 工具：让 agent 可以探测任意 HTTP(S) 端点的状态码、延迟和关键响应头（不读取响应体）。适合 API 健康检查和"这个服务挂了吗"类问题。

dsh-http-probe README · dsh-http-probe：HEAD is the default; a 405 (method not allowed) or 501 (method not implemented) response is retried once as GET. This supports servers that implement GET but omit HEAD. An explicit GET returning either status is reported without a retry. The probe cancels its unread GET body after receiving headers, including streaming bodies. This releases an unshared response promptly. If middleware has cloned the body, only the probe's branch is cancelled; upstream downloading can continue while another reader keeps its branch open. Latency measures the time to receive the headers. If an unread body has already failed, the received status and headers are still reported. Cancellation is started without awaiting it: when middleware clones a streaming response, completing cancellation can depend on the other reader, which must not block the probe result.

dsh-http-probe README · dsh-http-probe：默认使用 HEAD，遇到 405（不允许该方法）或 501（未实现该方法）时回退一次 GET，兼容只实现 GET 的服务。显式 GET 若返回这些状态码，则直接报告，不再重试。获取响应头后会取消探测所持有的 GET 响应体，包括持续流式响应；未共享的响应会及时释放。若中间件克隆了响应体，只取消探测自身的分支；另一位读取者保持其分支开启时，上游仍可能继续下载。延迟统计为获取响应头耗时。未读取的响应体若已失败，仍保留已经收到的状态码和响应头。取消操作会立即发起，但不等待其完成：中间件若克隆了流式响应，取消完成可能依赖另一位读取者，不应因此阻塞探测结果。

Cancelling the Harness tool call also aborts its pending HTTP request and prevents a HEAD-to-GET retry. Each request still has its own 10-second timeout.

dsh-http-probe README · dsh-http-probe：Method names follow Fetch: `DELETE`, `GET`, `HEAD`, `OPTIONS`, `POST` and `PUT` are normalized to uppercase. Other methods retain their exact casing, so `PATCH` and `patch` can probe different server behavior.

取消 Harness 工具调用时，会同时中止尚未完成的 HTTP 请求，并阻止后续 GET 回退。每次请求仍保留独立的 10 秒超时。

方法名遵循 Fetch 规则：`DELETE`、`GET`、`HEAD`、`OPTIONS`、`POST` 和 `PUT` 会规范为大写，其它方法保留原始大小写，因此 `PATCH` 与 `patch` 可用于探测服务端不同的处理行为。

dsh-http-probe README · Install / 安装：> Not on npm yet, so install straight from GitHub. pnpm will ask you to allow this package's build script once (dsh prints the exact line to add); that's the `prepare` step compiling TypeScript.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:po-et/dsh-http-probe
```

Then ask the agent something like: *"Probe https://example.com and tell me if it's healthy."*

dsh-http-probe README · Development / 开发：```sh
npm install
npm run build
npm test        # build and test with local HTTP servers; no external endpoint required
npm run dev     # dsh web --patch ./dev.cordis.yml, then open http://127.0.0.1:3080

`dev.cordis.yml` loads the built plugin by absolute path; edit it if you cloned this repo to a different location. Rebuild after changing `src/`.
